campaign.title: W=Y^(7/16) actual determinant-fibre and character high-pass gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary sources may guide determinant, Kloosterman-fraction, bilinear, or local-discrepancy strategy only after every literal coefficient, one-sided cutoff, norm, and theorem hypothesis is matched. No source analogy has proof status.

frozen_target.question: Can the literal one-sided reduced-determinant correlation at W=Y^(7/16) exploit its M1 denominator or M2 numerator character high-pass, centre phase, and lift transforms to prove O(Y^(1/2+epsilon)), a target-safe strict block subrange, or a quantified saving; or does the exact determinant-fibre transform self-return with its smallest signed survivor named?
frozen_target.reference_formula: O_i=2 Re sum_{0<n=ab'-a'b<kappa_i bb'/W} A_i(a,b) conjugate(A_i(a',b')) e(cn/(kappa_i bb')) (1-Wn/(kappa_i bb')), with kappa_1=1, kappa_2=4, W=Y^(7/16), c asymp Y, and A_i the complete literal reduced-ray coefficient. In increments p=a'-a, q=b'-b, n=aq-bp. M1 has b,b' odd, q=2r and chi_4(b)chi_4(b')=(-1)^r; M2 has a,a' odd, p=2s and chi_4(a)chi_4(a')=(-1)^s.
quantities: Y large real, c in a fixed comparable interval, W=Y^(7/16)
one fixed moving-symbol stratum and one hard block D=Y^delta, L=Y^ell in H_95
literal frequencies a/(kappa_i b), both signs, kappa_1=1 and kappa_2=4
complete lift coefficients A_1=(constant chi_4(b)/a) sum_g chi_4(g)U_1(g)/g and A_2=(constant chi_4(|a|)/|a|) sum_g chi_4(g)U_2(g)/g
target Y^(1/2+epsilon); minimax coefficient-blind deficit Y^(19/48)
full target implies internal exponent 5/16=0.3125 after accepted assembly, but not M9 or the quarter theorem
no determinantwise, character-sector, liftwise, raywise, or blockwise absolute value may hide the required signed cancellation

completion_criteria: Rederive the exact one-sided determinant kernel from the complete reduced-ray coefficients and certify the M1/M2 character placements, parities, both signs, factor four, and equal-lift owner.
Derive the increment chart n=aq-bp, the exact character high-pass in q for M1 and p for M2, and the phase identity cn/(kappa b(b+q))=ca/(kappa b)-c(a+p)/(kappa(b+q)).
Price the determinant strip in both orientations, including lengths D^2/(WL) and D/W at minimax, all gcd congruences, boundary triangles, and every Cauchy or transform factor.
State an explicit signed inequality or fibre norm whose left side contains the complete literal survivor and whose right side is at or below the claimed capacity.
Prove the Y^(1/2) target, a target-safe strict block region, a quantified positive-power saving, or a rigorous no-go for a named determinant-fibre/high-pass mechanism.
Show why the argument does not also prove the phase-conjugated Y^(43/48) coefficient-adversary analogue.
Audit every external theorem against the one-sided determinant cutoff, real centre c, coefficient norms, moving-symbol uniformity, and M1/M2 character placement.
Do not claim M9-M1, M9-M2, endpoint uniformity, M9, or the quarter theorem from this graded lane. Report an exponent improvement only if the complete local-moment and all-block implication is proved.

tasks.target: Independently rederive the literal determinant-increment and character-high-pass chart from the supplied fixed-block statement, price both strip orientations and capacities, and either state a lawful signed target or prove the first exact obstruction.
excluded_context: all Round-94 and Round-95 reports and reviews
the Round-117 derivation packet and conductor candidate
required_output: The exact increment, parity-character, phase, and strip charts.
A candidate signed inequality with every norm and capacity charged, or a precisely scoped no-go.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Exploit the exact M1 q-high-pass or M2 p-high-pass, centre phase, and determinant congruence to prove the strongest literal block estimate available, or isolate the first irreducible signed fibre norm with a complete exponent ledger.
required_output: The strongest proved target, strict subrange, saving, or exact signed survivor.
Every Poisson, B-process, geometric-sum, Cauchy, and divisor factor charged.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit the character-high-pass determinant mechanism for involution, coherent actual sectors, large-sieve diagonals, congruence multiplicity, owner loss, and exact primary-source theorem fit.
required_output: A pass/fail table for algebra, progressions, strip widths, norms, sources, owners, and downstream scope.
A rigorous named no-go if the mechanism self-returns, or the exact theorem still required.

review_seams.requirement: Every reduced-ray coefficient, lift character, parity support, sign, factor four, profile, floor, hard top, and star is retained.
The one-sided determinant, increment chart, phase identity, parity progressions, and both strip orientations agree exactly.
Primitive-ray, determinant-fibre, gcd, congruence, and boundary multiplicities are all charged before a norm step.
Every high-pass, geometric-sum, transform, large-sieve, and Cauchy factor is compared with the block capacity and Y^(1/2) target.
Any saving uses a literal property unavailable to the phase-conjugated Y^(43/48) adversary.
Every external theorem is matched to the exact one-sided cutoff, coefficient norm, real centre, parameter ranges, and character placement.
Equal lifts, moving strata, bottom, R5, signs, and cross-block terms are counted once with no false reversal of the positive kernel.
A block saving is not called a global exponent improvement without the full all-block local moment, and the graded lane is not called M9 or the quarter theorem.
